Theme

## Philosophy quotes about mind

Philosophy of mind asks what consciousness, thought, and mental life are—and how they relate to body and world.

20 passages · 8+ thinkers in this selection

### Why this theme matters

Dualism, materialism, functionalism, and phenomenological descriptions compete. AI renews old questions about understanding and experience.

### In the history of philosophy

From Aristotle’s psyche and Buddhist analyses of mind to Descartes, Wittgenstein, and cognitive science, the theme spans metaphysics and epistemology.

### Thinkers in this collection

[Arthur Schopenhauer](https://www.philosophydef.com/thinkers/arthur-schopenhauer) , [Bertrand Russell](https://www.philosophydef.com/thinkers/bertrand-russell) , [Dhammapada](https://www.philosophydef.com/thinkers/dhammapada) , [Diamond Sutra](https://www.philosophydef.com/thinkers/diamond-sutra) , [Wang Yangming](https://www.philosophydef.com/thinkers/wang-yangming) , [Boethius](https://www.philosophydef.com/thinkers/boethius) , [Baruch Spinoza](https://www.philosophydef.com/thinkers/baruch-spinoza) , [John Locke](https://www.philosophydef.com/thinkers/john-locke)

### Frequently asked questions

#### What is the mind in philosophy?

It names the locus of thought, feeling, and consciousness—whether as soul, brain process, or patterned activity.

#### Can machines have minds?

That depends on what mind requires: behavior, information processing, or subjective experience. The debate remains open.

#### Where are philosophy quotes about mind?

This theme collects English passages on thought, awareness, and inner life.
